title: FADS1 serves as a candidate shared biomarker for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis related early-onset colorectal cancer identified via machine learning and in vitro validation
summary: ML nominates FADS1 as a candidate shared biomarker in MASH-associated early-onset colorectal cancer, with public-cohort analyses and limited laboratory assays. Authors describe associations and acknowledge no direct genetic perturbation; the result is exploratory.
ai_technology: glmBoost and XGBoost selected from 44 evaluated machine-learning configurations
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: PDF Methods/Results: 44 algorithm configurations select glmBoost+XGBoost; external cohorts, single-cell virtual knockout, cell-line qPCR/WB, and small IHC sets (4 EO-CRC, 4 LO-CRC). Authors note no direct perturbation and association-only mechanism.
